alias: Tasks – Switch off marks the task done
description: Keeps an existing on/off helper working as a 'done' button for one alarm task. The Tasks service turns <SWITCH_ENTITY> on when the task comes due and off when it is done or snoozed (HA_SWITCH_TASKS in .env). Turning it off by hand marks the current occurrence done; the service's own off-flips run as its HA user and are ignored, so a snooze never counts as done.

data.done_by: {{ states.person | selectattr('attributes.user_id', 'eq', trigger.to_state.context.user_id) | map(attribute='name') | first | default('switch') }}
